ModMetaData.name: RimMT
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT V0.4.19-JS1.2.1 JD1 AutoTrace is a diagnostic build based exactly on Lean Hybrid gameplay behavior. It does not add a new optimization. After 600 main-thread frames, the first JobGiver_Work.TryIssueJobPackage taking at least 64 ms arms a one-shot detail capture on the following frame. The next 32 outer JobPackages are temporarily instrumented across WorkGiver phases, GenClosest, Reachability.CanReach, RegionTraverser.BreadthFirstTraverse, and scanner source enumeration; the detours automatically unpatch when the capture completes. The triggering slow package itself remains uninstrumented so the trigger reflects normal Hybrid behavior. ReachProfile, WorkPrefilter, nearest-order reuse, haul accelerators, Path shadow policy, Jobs, reservations and final Vanilla authority are unchanged. This build is intended only to identify the dominant JobGiver bottleneck under the current heavy save workload.
